macros.name: ParallelAtEnd
macros.doc: With the help of \ParallelAtEnd (\renewcommand{\ParallelAtEnd}{<Your text here>}) you can set some text between the parallel columns and the footnotes.

macros.name: ParallelPar
macros.doc: \ParallelPar is the most important Macro of this package; it tells the environment to begin a new parallel paragraph, i.e.: left and right texts are printed out to their lengths and then we begin new on the same vertical position, as if you close the environment Parallel and begin a new one.
